programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep10
programme.desc: On the day before a holy fete where the current king stands before his people donning the first king's mantle, a divine night triggers and Leonhart remains in his human form the next day.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep3
programme.desc: Nene vows to get back at Arisu for seeing them undressed by catching him in an embarrassing situation. After school, they spot him entering a cafe, and they see him dressed as a waiter!?

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep4
programme.desc: Shinobu Uzuki is swamped with work as the school's sports festival approaches. The club members worry she might be pushing herself. Seeing this, Arisu takes her to a quiet spot...

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep6
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep7
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep3
programme.desc: With Christmas around the corner, Chitoge is terrified at the idea of introducing Raku to her mother as her boyfriend. Who is Chitoge's mom and what will become of their Christmas?

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep4
programme.desc: Chitoge asks her mother, Hana, to spend Christmas Eve with her and is turned down. Raku is determined to resolve all misunderstandings between the two.

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep5
programme.desc: Marika faces the prospect of having to retake her next exam. She asks Raku to look after her pet parrot for a day. Being an animal lover, he agrees. However, pet-sitting turns out to be a major ordeal.

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep6
programme.desc: It's Valentine's Day. Although Raku has never received chocolates before, he can't help feeling hopeful. Meanwhile, Chitoge, Marika, and Kosaki have each crafted chocolates in their own way.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep14
programme.desc: Armin and Mikasa speak with Eren, but are astounded by what he says. In the forest, Levi considers feeding the Beast Titan to someone new, but Zeke has other plans in mind.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep15
programme.desc: A look into Zeke's past shows his struggle to become a Warrior. His plans to end the suffering of all Eldians stems from a chance friendship made in his youth.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep16
programme.desc: With the Jaegerists now in charge, Zeke's master plan is revealed. But before it is put in motion, Eren recruits help to flush out any invaders in their midst.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Part 2 Ep17
programme.desc: Marley launches a surprise attack on the Shiganshina District where it all began, and the Titans make their move. The Founding Titan and Armored Titan face off once more.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep11
programme.desc: Raphael tells Foll what he knows about her father, Orbas the Wise, and warns of an impending crisis. Chastille teams up with Zagan to defeat the Chimera, and receives a request from Raphael.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep12
programme.desc: Foll continues living with Zagan and Nephy while Raphael is hired as their butler. While shopping at town for a dinner party with Chastille, they find a broken gramophone at Manuela's shop.

programme.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke up Piloting the Strongest Starship! Ep7
programme.desc: Takahiro 'Hiro' is reborn into his favourite game, commanding the best starship. He journeys across space as a mercenary to fulfil his dream of buying an expensive house with a garden.

programme.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess With Zero Believers Ep6
programme.desc: Makoto and his classmates are transported to another world, but he is the only weak one. Pairing up with a forgotten goddess, Noah, Makoto aims for the top using unorthodox methods, hardcore mode!

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep8
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep9
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Ep13
programme.desc: The stolen tome and Philomela's withdrawal. While the two events unfold, the College is placed under lockdown. The students take on lessons to acquire the ability to protect themselves.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Ep14
programme.desc: Two witches arrive at London and seek the missing tome. Meanwhile, Philomela rests in bed. The feeling of kindness, unfamiliar to her, is pulling at her heartstrings.

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart OVA Ep1
programme.desc: Spin-off series of 'The Dangers in My Heart', featuring stories that focus on the introverted Ichikawa and the naive Yamada in an everyday routine that'll make you chuckle!

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep1
programme.desc: Ichikawa struggles at school with his broken arm. With Adachi's help, Yamada indirectly supports Ichikawa. Having felt Yamada's kindness, Ichikawa decides to tell her his feelings...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep1
programme.desc: Nukumizu witnesses his classmate, Anna, get dumped, and gets to know the 'losing heroines', Lemon and Chika. Nukumizu's mysterious youth story revolving around these 'Makeines' begins!

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep2
programme.desc: Lemon invites Nukumizu to talk in the gym storage room, but they get locked inside. They get rescued as childhood friend Ayano visits Lemon. Then, they visit the Literature Club together...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep3
programme.desc: Nukumizu and Komari debate about tap water. The Literature Club goes on a training camp to produce a web novel as proof of their club activities. At night, a fireworks accident happens...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep4
programme.desc: Komari confesses to Tamaki. Tensions between Koto and Tamaki flare up as Koto leaves the site. Nukumizu escapes reality, but to no avail. Later, Nukumizu hears a rumor about him and Yanami.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep5
programme.desc: Yanami visits Nukumizu and Kaju overreacts. Yanami invites Nukumizu to a cafe and they spot Lemon and Ayano together. They follow the two, but are approached by Ayano's girlfriend, Chihaya.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep6
programme.desc: Ayano grills Nukumizu who was with Chihaya. He then misunderstands that Nukumizu likes Yanami. Including Lemon and Yanami, they hang out while Lemon tries to hook Ayano and Chihaya up, but...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep7
programme.desc: Lemon tells Nukumizu her feelings for Ayano and confronts Ayano and Chihaya. Nighttime at school, Lemon and Ayano share their feelings and reminisce about the past. Lemon then makes a move...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep8
programme.desc: Nukumizu and Komari become vice president and president of the literature club. Yanami proposes an idea for their exhibition at the Tsuwabuki Festival. Things seem to be going well, but...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep9
programme.desc: While preparing for the festival, Nukumizu and Komari catch Tamaki and Koto on a date. Unable to interact with them like before, Komari decides to prepare the exihibit's manuscript alone.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep10
programme.desc: Preparation for the exhibition is complete and Komari returns. At the festival, Nukumizu and Komari tour around the campus. Later, Koto talks to Nukumizu while Komari is alone with Tamaki...

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep11
programme.desc: Komari struggles to practice for the club presidents' meeting. Upon Yanami's suggestion, they head out but Nukumizu and Komari end up arguing. They remain at odds as the meeting day arrives.

programme.title: Makeine: Too Many Losing Heroines! Ep12
programme.desc: Yanami ropes the club members into her 'fake boyfriend project', leading to a mock date between her and Nukumizu. Ms. Konuki gifts some tickets to Non Hoi Park, which becomes the date venue.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep4
programme.desc: Kuroe brings Iroha and Yachiyo to Hotel Fendt Hope, where they run into the Amane sisters. Iroha and Kuroe head towards Nemu's quarters but are stopped by Black Wings Rena and Kaede.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep5
programme.desc: Kuroe accompanies Iroha to search for her friends from the Mikazuki Dorm. The feelings of the girls who serve the Magius grow complicated as Toka reveals a plan to save all magical girls...

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep11
programme.desc: Anubis declares Sariphi as the queen's representative. Sariphi's presence is made known to the greater public and thus, incurs backlash. Watching the events unfold, Amit decides to cheer Sariphi up.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep12
programme.desc: Sariphi struggles with her first task as the queen's representative due to the Queen of Sabre, Karkala's interference. Just then, the Fourth Princess, Tetra, appears with a solution.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep5
programme.desc: Shinobu is planning a 'Confession Relay' for the sports festival. But distributing flyers to publicize the event is tedious, so Nene comes up with an albeit embarrassing idea.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep6
programme.desc: The broadcasting club members celebrate the success of sports day with a party at Lemon's house. Iko calls out to sleeping Arisu, wondering why he was hugging Shinobu during the festival

programme.title: Sanggar Vista Ep7
programme.desc: Menjejak rumah-rumah cantik di Sarawak. Keindahan adalah subjektif, maka program ini menampil pelbagai jenis rumah, bukan hanya banglo mewah, tetapi juga rumah tradisional dan sederhana yang dihias indah.

programme.title: Pewaris Legasi Ep8
programme.desc: Dalam kebimbangan minat remaja pada kerjaya kraftangan, pewaris gigih menjaga warisan ini. Rancangan ini memaparkan kerjaya kraftangan di Malaysia, menyeru penonton menghargai usaha mempertahankannya.

programme.title: The Food That Binds the Nation Ep8
programme.desc: Sebuah dokumentari kembara gastronomi yang merentas dari Perlis ke Sarawak, memperkenalkan keunikan juadah berbilang budaya yang memupuk perpaduan dalam kepelbagaian selera.

programme.title: Unearth Sarawak: Indigenous Cuisines Ep4
programme.desc: Showcases iconic and forgotten cuisines from Bidayuh, Melanau, Chinese, Iban, and Orang Ulu ethnics, aiming to preserve heritage cuisines, boost local communities, and promote gastronomy tourism.

programme.title: The Human Odyssey Ep1
programme.desc: Dokumentari ini menelusuri kisah asal usul dan pengembaraan manusia sejagat dalam memahami siapa kita dan dari mana kita datang melalui lakonan semula dan rekaan visual yang menarik.

programme.title: Stories in Motion Ep6

programme.desc: 《消失的子弹》原班人马打造，尔冬升监制、刘青云和全新阵容林家栋和凤小岳联合主演。神探松东路迎接难解奇案的挑战，一场全城惶恐的杀人游戏，唯有靠更多的死亡和牺牲才能换来真相大白，犹如东方福尔摩斯电影。

programme.title: 少年的你
programme.desc: 一名高中女生在忙着面对高考的压力和应付残酷的霸凌时，结识了一个街头混混。他们的一生将因一宗谋杀案而改变...

programme.title: 花田囍事
programme.desc: 此片乃著名喜剧导演高志森的作品。故事发生在北宋年间，各主角经历了重重误会险阻，闹出多段错综杂、一塌糊涂的冤家情缘，过程荒唐惹笑，却又情味浓。

programme.title: 不要忘记我爱你
programme.desc: 如果你的恋人忘记你，你还有勇气让他再一次爱上你吗?陆尧患上了失忆症，每天醒来都会忘记昨天发生的一切。当陆尧遇上心理治疗师星玥，两人坠入爱河，虽知没有未来也愿意为了彼此勇敢爱一次。

programme.title: 爆水管
programme.desc: 全镇无贼，警察失业?为保铁饭碗，警探于大海决定带队自导自演一场「大劫案」。与此同时，警局脚下的盗墓贼正悄悄挖向宝藏。一场水管爆裂，局势瞬间失控，警与贼的身份也在混乱中不断反转。

programme.title: 12怪盗
programme.desc: 地下组织「怪盗公会」的12个天才怪盗各自身怀绝技，但欠缺默契。12人必须重新燃起团魂，一起完成拯救世界免于灾难的使命。

programme.title: 向阳花
programme.desc: 高月香为了给女儿购买人工耳蜗误入歧途，被判刑入狱。狱中，她结识了三名女友人。出狱后，四人不向命运低头，携手迎难而上，互相扶持，共同向阳而生！

programme.title: 激战
programme.desc: 香港过气拳王程辉为了避债，躲在澳门残喘偷生。富二代林思齐为了亲情，决定参加混合格斗比赛，并拜辉为师。两个曾经风光一时的失意人，为了不同的人生目的，一起站上格斗擂台，展开热血激战！

programme.title: 賭神2
programme.desc: 赌神高进退出赌坛，与妻子过着隐居生活。但野心勃勃的台湾帮主蓄意要成为新赌神，不惜杀害其怀孕的妻子，迫高进重出江湖，然后消灭他。高进怀着悲愤的心情，决定与帮主决战，替妻儿报仇。

programme.title: 鹦鹉杀
programme.desc: 周冉在一次网恋中被骗。循着骗子留下的蛛丝马迹，周冉来到沿海小城，并意外结识两名青年。周冉渐渐发现二人与骗案有关，一场复仇之计也由此展开。

programme.title: 边缘行者
programme.desc: 故事讲述1997年香港回归前夕，多方势力矛盾激化，暴力事件频发生。在巨变当前，黑帮龙头委派阿骆主理毒品生意，但原来阿骆是警方的卧底。在调查期间，他更揭发一场惊人的政治阴谋。

programme.title: 南京照相馆
programme.desc: 1937年南京沦陷，一群躲在吉祥照相馆避难的百姓，为了尽可能的多活一天，被迫为日军冲洗底片，却意外冲出屠城证据。他们决定冒险保存底片，并将日军屠杀的罪证公诸于世。

programme.title: 南京照相馆
programme.desc: 1937年南京沦陷，一群躲在吉祥照相馆避难的百姓，为了尽可能的多活一天，被迫为日军冲洗底片，却意外冲出屠城证据。他们决定冒险保存底片，并将日军屠杀的罪证公诸于世。

programme.title: 失衡凶间
programme.desc: 由陈果、冯志强、许业生分别执导，讲述三个在城市森林角落发生的诡异离奇故事。年轻歌手搬到新居，因为感应到灵异生物而导致抑郁症复发；网红的商场表演，最后却变成死亡直播；唐楼租客联手对抗楼梯间的神秘怪客。

programme.title: 惊天救援
programme.desc: 以真实事件改编，剧情讲述一场突如其来的地震波及整个化工园区，管道泄漏触发爆炸不断，邻近地区火光冲天。灾难迅速升级，消防救援站的队员们第一时间奔赴重灾区，危难时刻争分夺秒，用生命守护生命。

programme.title: 不是你不爱你
programme.desc: 平凡少女阿宝偶遇不务正业的富家子家伟。他们密谋捣乱家伟父亲的婚礼，二人也因而堕入爱河。岂料命运却为这段爱情安排了急转直下的暗涌...

programme.title: 危机航线
programme.desc: 一架A380航班在首航中遭到枪手劫持。国际保安专家高皓军恰好是机上的乘客，而他的女儿不幸成为人质。面对这场生死攸关的危机，高皓军能否成功拯救机上所有乘客，并化解危机?

programme.title: 人约离婚后
programme.desc: 宝发现强出轨，在婚礼上播放他偷情画面后宣布离婚。恢复单身的两人保持友好关系，一天强竟骗宝参加换妻派对，遇上杰和丽两夫妻，各自寻欢。直到宝和杰开始交往，强才意识到自己始终在乎宝，他能挽回前妻的心吗?

programme.title: 除暴
programme.desc: 真实改编中国惊天劫案，刑警钟诚受命追捕犯下惊天连环劫案的老鹰帮，首领张隼更屡次恶意挑衅钟诚。刑警小队对他们咬死不放，数年间，警匪上演了一次次紧张刺激的较量，双方最终展开殊死对决。

programme.title: 倒数回击
programme.desc: 天才拳击手徐佳阳为了还赌债在地下酒馆打黑拳时被举报，痛失奥运资格赛，陨落拳坛。十年后，铁血教练陈丽月决要助她重回拳坛。徐佳阳能否再度燃烧拳击梦?

programme.title: 速战人生
programme.desc: 改编自真人真事，影片讲述年轻的风为追寻成为汽车修理技师的梦想，不惜与父亲决裂离家。与青梅竹马的云一同踏上逐梦旅程，在机缘巧合下意外闯入充满刺激与挑战的赛车世界，展开一段热血沸腾的成长冒险。

programme.title: 我要做特务
programme.desc: 方妙龄对"特务"行业极度狂热，坚信梦想终会实现。一天，方妙龄误打误撞地救了负伤的特务，令对方答应收她为徒，从此，她的整个世界变得天翻地覆。集爆笑、动作、热血、奇情等元素，见证这个关于实现梦想的故事。

programme.title: 惊蛰无声
programme.desc: 最新战机核心技术泄密引发国安危机，特工小组在都市展开猎谍行动却屡遭重创；随着调查深入，矛头直指内部。两名王牌特工在猜忌与背叛中对峙，一场无声却残酷的较量悄然上演。

programme.title: 感动她77次
programme.desc: 这部都市爱情电影为《原谅他77次》续集，故事叙述恢复单身的Eva与泰国男神偶遇并互有好感，而前男友Adam仍希望通过努力换来Eva的第78次原谅。最终，他能成功挽回真爱吗?

programme.title: 断网
programme.desc: 黑客发动大规模的网络袭击，幸得网络保安主任卓家俊利用自己研发的防火墙化解危机。怎料病毒攻击原是由家俊上司所操控，家俊亦同时误堕其洗黑钱圈套，为证清白，二人展开激烈的网络攻防。

programme.title: 暗恋·橘生淮南
programme.desc: 改编八月长安小说，为电影《最好的我们》续篇。成绩优秀、生性骄傲的洛枳，暗恋着幼时有过一面之缘的盛淮南。大学再次同校，两人开始越走越近，洛枳依然不敢表白。当成长的压力接踵而来，这场漫长的暗恋该如何安放?

programme.title: 玫瑰战争 第12集
programme.desc: 改篇自吴沚默的小说《维多利亚的派对》。四位昔日姐妹因一封神秘来信，再次牵扯七年前的死亡谜团！关子盈究竟是自杀还是被害?复出的夏无双誓要找出真凶，利用姐妹间的猜忌展开复仇。谁是凶手?谁又是复仇者?

programme.title: 天涯侠医 第8集
programme.desc: 两个同样卓越不凡、才华洋溢的医生─妇产科的王甫芬与心脏内科的齐百恒，各有心销与梦魇，透过一个人道救援组织LifeForce，二人远赴非洲参与医疗任务，在当地宏美的大自然景色下，彼此认识对方，亦让二人一再反思生命的意义。

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第16集
programme.desc: 陈展鹏、吴若希、洪永城领衔主演，呈现香港人在内地的"北漂"的故事。讲述投资失利的徐港仁携妻子移居北京发展事业，面对内地与香港迥异的生活方式、文化和语言差异等各种挑战后，令他们对爱情和生活有了新的体悟。

programme.title: 射雕英雄传 第18集
programme.desc: 改编自同名武侠小说，张智霖伙拍朱茵、罗嘉良和关宝慧重新诠释金庸笔下的郭靖、黄蓉、杨康及穆念慈。精彩故事情节，陪你回顾射雕英雄的经典典故。

programme.title: 跳跃生命线 第23集

programme.title: 食尚玩家 鱼肉乡民
programme.desc: 新生代主持人零九和小赖"赖上了"每集的乡民代表，对他们予取予求，当一日的"美食寄生虫"！跟随大队一起品尝各地的私房美食，踩点当地人才知道的独家景点。

programme.title: 一步一脚印 发现新台湾
programme.desc: 台湾到处有充满创意、认真工作的人们，「一步一脚印，发现新台湾」将呈现出真实而全面的新台湾精神。

programme.title: 鹰王
programme.desc: 少年侠士鹰王因得知天一帮帮主，遭该帮舵主洪擎天杀死的真相，而被卷入是非漩涡之中。鹰王躲避舵主手下追杀期间，巧遇天一帮七舵主颜玉莲，决意联手对付幕后黑手，进而掀起一场无可避免的生死战。

programme.title: 天使出更
programme.desc: 陈友 I 林建明 I 张坚庭

programme.title: 鬼新娘
programme.desc: 青年商人聂云鹏与封阿奴，及仆人大火子与婢女魏银儿双双成亲，众人皆欣羡其主仆艳福；却原来封实是冯爱娇冤魂附体，二十年前遭聂之二叔奸杀，冯这次回来，正为报一己之仇!

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传续集
programme.desc: 武侠片大师张彻导演与倪匡联手拍摄的金庸名着，重现郭靖与黄蓉曲折多磨的爱情故事。憨厚的郭靖如何击退情敌欧阳克?机智的黄蓉又如何接替洪七公，成为丐帮新任帮主呢?

programme.title: 梅山收七怪
programme.desc: 故事讲述小哪咤偷吃了一个仙桃，但又不慎将另外七个仙桃弄落凡间，导致七只不同动物变成妖怪。哪咤要在十天内收复妖怪，否则父亲会被天帝惩罚，最后哪咤能否完成任务?

programme.title: 金石情
programme.desc: 取材自民间故事，罗维自导自演，与黄梅调反串女王凌波、林玉，演绎麻疯女刘贞莲与穷书生李孝文之间，可泣可歌的爱情故事。

programme.title: 双喜临门
programme.desc: 李明珠与朱国栋学成回国预备结婚，但两者父亲却不和，后朱李装死。但两父的反应不一，朱父见爱子因婚姻不自由而死，答应他们死后结婚，然而李父却坚决不肯！有趣的配乐，两老斗戏带来无穷"笑"果。

programme.title: 五郎八卦棍
programme.desc: 功夫电影一代宗师刘家良身兼导编演，与动作巨星傅声、刘家辉和汪禹合作，悲壮慷慨的剧情，讲述杨家将五郎报国仇、了家恨的精彩故事。这部电影是刘家良后期的代表作之一，更是巨星傅声的不朽遗作。

programme.title: 丑闻
programme.desc: 小混混甄明和贾亮潜入县长办公室意欲行窃时，发现官员的丑闻记录。这时，县长遭民众围殴昏厥，与县长容貌相似的贾亮上演狸猫换太子，与各怀鬼胎的官员们展开大斗法！这场风波越演越烈，最终要如何收场?

programme.title: 龙虎斗
programme.desc: 王羽首次自导自演，创下1970年香港华语电影票房总冠军的奠基之作，掀起港台功夫片潮流。戏中王羽以铁砂掌击败日本空手道高手，展现不畏强权的民族精神，也突破早期武侠电影框架，创造新格局！

programme.title: 杨乃武与小白菜
programme.desc: 清末四大奇案之一，多番被改编搬成电影和电视剧。小白菜曾与杨乃武相恋，婚后虽恪守妇道，仍被乡人讥笑。后知县之子刘子和垂涎菜美色，受药店老板钱保生怂恿将菜迷奸，刘毒杀菜夫，并嫁祸给杨乃武！

programme.title: 卖命小子
programme.desc: 拍摄于武侠片高峰期，袁鹰飞，表面上是大仁大义的江湖侠士，实则是奸险小人。他利用何非、冯加金、曾樵及杨追风等失意江湖的高手，对付关云；岂料何非等四人与关云不打不相识，反成了好友。

programme.title: 鱼美人
programme.desc: 凌波反串饰书生张珍，李菁则一人分饰两角。张珍与金牡丹指腹为婚，但张家道中落，岳丈金宠藉词张需考取功名，才可成亲。此片荣获亚洲影展最佳女主角、最佳才艺奖、最佳录音奖，为凌波和李菁最具代表性的黄梅调电影。

programme.title: 插翅虎
programme.desc: 武林两大恶魔邓飞和阴得龙，各别拥有武圣留下的一半武功秘本。阴得龙为了独霸武林，将胞妹阴赛花招赘邓飞。郭九如为了挽救武林浩劫，冒充邓飞前去赴会，却被识破身份，陷入重重包围！

programme.title: 插翅虎
programme.desc: 武林两大恶魔邓飞和阴得龙，各别拥有武圣留下的一半武功秘本。阴得龙为了独霸武林，将胞妹阴赛花招赘邓飞。郭九如为了挽救武林浩劫，冒充邓飞前去赴会，却被识破身份，陷入重重包围！

programme.title: 樑上君子
programme.desc: 徐虾导演，董骠、钱小豪、罗莽及蒋金联手发放笑弹的经典喜剧。职业扒手骠叔刑满出狱，欲与两名弟子裘奇和马祥干一番大事业之际，却不幸被保安队长铁力威盯上，进而展开一场斗智斗谋的兵贼之战。

programme.title: 大杀四方
programme.desc: 北方军阀混战，百姓纷纷向南逃难。王绪、金正平和鱼汉生三位青年，也夹在难民群中来到战区边沿的小镇。该镇富家子弟陈祖光气势凌人，王因出手营救一女难民而被陈之手下追捕，幸得风尘女子红菱所救。

programme.title: 目无王法
programme.desc: 何中衡、秦英豪、罗正是三个初出茅庐的捕快，秉持除暴安良，维护法纪的宗旨。县内赌馆妓院，都遭他们严厉扫荡。然而县官和其他捕头目无王法，贪财害民，他们拒绝同流合污，却惨遭陷害！究竟，正义能否战胜强权?

programme.title: 武林风云
programme.desc: 故事描述武义亲王恃势弄权，为夺紫光剑，不惜害死甘大雄、并命其以弔祭为名，实行武力夺剑。甘氏三女能否保这住紫光剑?紫光剑到底藏着什么重大秘密呢?正邪对立，让人热血沸腾！

programme.title: 剑女幽魂
programme.desc: 台湾七十年代最著名的武侠片导演郭南宏指导，故事讲述剑圣女儿受命将早前偷来的金龙宝剑送回京师，途中却遭邪主毒害身亡。她为报此仇，藉宝剑灵气还魂，竭尽全力将剑还给皇上，升天而去。

programme.title: 不了情
programme.desc: 一代影后林黛携手关山，上演夜总会歌女李青青与俏郎君汤鹏南之间，可泣可歌的爱情故事。此片当年不仅取得票房冠军，林黛在片中的精湛演出，也让她四度夺得亚洲影展影后殊荣。

programme.title: 茅山殭尸拳
programme.desc: 以赶尸为业的陈五与徒弟范振元因同时赶着九具尸体上路，顾此失彼下，走失了两具僵尸；其中一具光头僵尸实非真僵尸，而是江湖汉子，因被奸人陷害而假扮僵尸。戏中僵尸拳颇有新意，汪禹的搞怪演出加分不少！

programme.title: 城市之光
programme.desc: 为让家人过更好的生活，陈柏子带着妻子和两个女儿，远从中国来到香港投靠父亲。殊不知父亲在香港的生活，并非信中所言般富足。东方之珠的美梦，换来的竟是悲喜交集的苦日子?

programme.title: 十二金牌
programme.desc: 从秦桧发出十二道金牌给岳飞的史实演绎而来的。片中秦桧收买邪恶帮派连送十二道金牌命令岳飞退军，不料纷纷被江湖义士在半路劫杀！导演程刚发挥了合理的想像，故事曲折，运镜流畅，被誉为导演最有惊喜的武侠佳作！

programme.title: 怒海情仇
programme.desc: 罗维执导、张彻编辑，李丽华和杜蝶主演，故事发生在一个渔村里，讲述恶霸之子为追求美女，不慎陷入一场纠缠不清、腥风血雨的斗争中。

programme.title: 大罗剑侠
programme.desc: 女侠明珠的师父惨遭黑虎帮歹徒杀死，为完成师父遗愿，防止失踪宝藏落入黑虎帮手中，明珠逐踏上一趟冒险之旅。途中巧遇"大罗剑侠"周应龙，在对方协助下，联手对抗黑虎帮，为江湖铲除祸害！

programme.title: 春火
programme.desc: 武侠巨星王羽少有的时装片之一，卸下大侠身份，饰演一名愤世嫉俗的青年。扣人心弦的剧情，讲述青年杨国良因不满警探父亲长期忽略家庭，毅然走向歪路，使父子二人的关系愈演愈僵。

programme.title: 报仇
programme.desc: 被誉为大导演张彻的巅峰之作，故事简单但结构奇特，引人入胜，大获好评！武生关玉楼得知妻子红杏出墙，却遭人暗算害死。关小楼为兄报仇，不料误中奸人诡计，危机四伏！

programme.title: 阿牛入城记
programme.desc: 生性憨直的大牛到香港后，经常被坏人利用，尝尽低下阶层社会的人情冷暖，最后更遭逢入狱的恶运！天生乐观的阿牛，最终能不能吉人天相?
